parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the minute.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
> You can invoke [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the minute.
